note: A great ascension leaves an unbroken shell, published debris and fragments that are never displayed again, so the debris field is the single largest and best-dated food supply on the plains and a pack that has timed a season to a publication is not a wild population.

A claim to a dead resource is the only claim the plains can still honour, and this pack inherits that estate by eating it: worked-out ground, dead miners and standing spoil are the same gradient, so scavenging and holding the worked-out face are the same act.

The one public account on the plains is a weight of spoil moved by every crew, kept where the crews can read it, and a scavenger's entire range is a function of where crews break and where they leave something; the tally is therefore the pack's map and the pack's reason to stay out of the guilds' way.

A breakthrough calendar is a schedule published a season ahead, and knowing it would let a pack predict where bodies will be produced rather than only where they were; no guild has ever taught it to a scavenger and every guild has had the same reason.

The mortuary college reads the dead as the frame said and the village remembers them otherwise, and the Cinder Famine left the two records disagreeing about who was even present; a pack eats the difference, which is why the disagreement is a food supply and a grievance at the same time.

No march order on the plains can be enforced by measurement, so every claim is settled by a marker left standing, and a scavenger is the population that makes standing a question rather than a formality: nothing survives a gradient that feeds on it.

Spoil does not disperse where spatial law is unspent, so forty years of it stands on the last unworked iron, and the waste guild that moves it reads the same heap as a cost and a pack reads it as a larder that has been standing still for four decades.

The guild that moves the heap off the seam floor cannot employ what it cannot catch, so the packs are tolerated inside its charter rather than members of it, and the arrangement is the reason the guild's tally is public where the extraction guild's is not.

A pack has no roll of its own, so the mortuary college's reading of a death is the only count that exists, and a scavenger that is entered as a cause of death and never as a population is how a species with no census ends up owning the census.

The culture publishes the whole recovery and forbids displaying the fragments again, and the prohibition is the only thing that keeps the debris unclaimed: nobody may cite a fragment nobody has seen, so the pack has an exclusive range the register household does not know it has.

The commons of the mortal plains works because nobody here expects to ascend and the work is judged by what survives the season, and that is precisely the rule a pack is shaped by: take what is left, be where the season is ending, and do not stay.

The town at the foot of the stair is the only settlement on the tier whose whole population is visitors, and the packs hold the gradient immediately below it where arrivals stop being people and become weight.

The plains' one large migratory herd returns on a cycle nobody on the ground has predicted and is therefore the tier's only moving calendar, so the pack's timing is borrowed wholesale from an animal it does not hunt and cannot follow without eating it.

A whole profession exists because spatial law is unspent, carrying waste that cannot be made to disperse, and haulage is what converts a standing heap into a trail of dropped weight; remove the profession and the pack has a larder nobody ever opens.

A scavenger is born where the dead are the most reliable food, and it is the exhaustion of one seam that put four decades of worked-out ground, dead crews and unmoved spoil onto a single leeward gradient for the first time.

A fire-affinity population burning its own reserve for a decade left on cold dry highland exactly the kind of quantity a heat-exchange scavenger can reach and nothing else can, and the pack's density is still traceable to that decade.

Strata under the plains carry tool marks that imply a hand on a frame that seats three law groups and none of them moves distance, and the only population that reaches the bottom of an unmoved spoil heap without moving anything is the one that cannot carry anything at all.

The reader of the law decides which doctrine tier a case may be heard under, which is access and never power, and a scavenger gradient is heard under no doctrine because it cannot be located to open a case; that is the whole reason a population can be cleared off a slope without a hearing.

The Sealed Core holds that the dead are unsealed at burial and their core resumes work in the frame, so on the plains a body is fuel and the dead are fuel not yet spent; a pack eats the unspent remainder and is the only population that would agree with the theology.

The afterlife the same faith teaches is a court of resumed fuel, and a pack's actual experience is that everything a court counts as resumed is instead carried off a slope inside a season, which is the gap that makes the faith need a prohibition against discussing scavengers.

In a mortal world nothing carries an element because elemental law was never written: seasons drift unanchored and ore has no affinity. The pack's fire affinity is therefore an appetite rather than a nature, which is why it eats the dead instead of becoming one of them.

The households that were working the seam hold the worked-out face as a title, and the species that breathes the belt's airborne grit is not a tenant of that title so much as its standing crop, turning up wherever a face is being cut.

The heap clan holds a crew and a number on a public spoil tally and no land at all, and the herd that walks the belt without folding it into an ore bed has the same relationship to the face: continuous presence, no claim, and a total dependence on somebody else's shift calendar.

Both are the belt's fire-adjacent answer to living on hot stone: the quenchbound house signs every child to a furnace because a fire-affinity body with no seated elemental law must burn its own reserve, and the ashwalker avoids that expense by filtering the grit instead of refining it.

The public account holds that realms three and four were a failure of will rather than a shortage of iron, repeated by exactly the interests whose position depends on ore being the lesser problem, and it cannot be taught here because this body is the standing evidence that the tier's ore problem was a physiology problem.

A breakthrough is prepared rather than attempted by a dose timed to a tide that will carry it, on a stone bed that holds qi, and the dose is dosed by weight against a body whose blood already carries suspended stone; the arithmetic cannot be trusted on this frame and nobody has ever tried.

The heap has stood on the last unworked iron for forty years because spatial law is unspent here, and the extraction guild needs the face back while the species that inhales the spoil has made its own load permanent by breathing it; both parties are right and the face is worth nothing to either.

The densest bodies stop one gate short of the end of their own tier and whoever profits from an unexplained ceiling wants the hole shut, while this body's own wall is the eighth gate and the liver rather than a seventeenth-realm density; the assay floor publishes nothing that would cover it.

A rift is a door with a timetable because it closes when the out-of-range law value returns inside its range, and every holder of that shore built their wall facing arrivals, so the belt's outside has been permanently indoors for a generation and this is what breathes the difference.

The guild that works the Ironhead Flats writes its shift and ventilation discipline around a herd that must be somewhere else every few hours, so the face is planned around a species rather than staffed by it and the roster is the only place either party records the arrangement.

A mineral-load body is read one way by the frame and remembered another way by the village, and a dead ashwalker leaves both an ore assay and a person, so the register keeps the raw reading and the settlement keeps the rest and neither record has ever been reconciled.

The guild builds and then guards doors and walls and takes as its measure that what it builds is tested from the other side, and the population that lives permanently on the inside of the belt's walls is what makes the test continuous rather than occasional.

Nobody on the plains expects to ascend and the work is judged by what survives the season, and this is the belt's commons: the one population whose survival is measured in kilograms of air rather than in harvests, and whose presence on the ground is itself the cost of cutting the face.

The chartered town at the mouth of the only verifiable hole in the setting exists because the quarry answers how much stone the ridge has left per unit of ground worked, and the herd that follows the shift calendar is the reason the answer can be given at all.

Four decades of spoil that has never moved has sterilised the ground around the seam, and a filter-feeding body with a mineral blood load is the only thing that can metabolise that scar, so the belt's dead ground is simultaneously the face's future and the herd's only habitat.

The grey lichen colonises worked stone wherever a large quantity of qi has been drawn through it, so every cut and every trial on this belt leaves a map, and a body that absorbs residual qi straight out of ash and stone follows that map without ever having been taught to.

Iron ore is the mortal tier's only dense material and the only thing here a body can be caged in, and this body's entire physiology is downstream of an ore supply that is exhausted: the filter works because the belt once produced something worth filtering.

Haulage is what converts a standing heap into airborne grit, so the profession that exists because spatial law is absent is also the mechanism that made this species viable, and every cut face needs one before it needs a crew.

Cultivators walked up the Tier Stair after the Iron Grief and did not come back, and the belt's prey population left with them while the belt stayed exactly where it was, which is why a species whose habitat is a working face outlived the workforce that justified the face.

The famine left bodies burning on this belt for a decade, and a filter feeder that metabolises mineral load out of air was the one scavenger physiology the burning could feed rather than poison; the belt's ash concentration is a famine signature.

A population crossed the stair and neither arrived nor sent word inside the one movement with more departures than arrivals, and this is the belt that watched them go: a herd that follows every shift and every departure has the only continuous record of that thinning.

A mortuary college keeps one sealed case for every death it cannot certify and the cases accumulate because certifying a death needs a body, and the population whose dead are systematically uncertifiable is the one whose miners' deaths cannot be closed.

Three auditors may sit at once and the fourth is refused on capacity rather than on law, and this body is the tier's cheapest throughput unit, so the refusal that matters on the plains is a refusal of bodies rather than a refusal of law and the register that records it is a mineral assay.

The only worked ground on the plains held by an institution that does not sell its output because the temple forge is public and its ore is accounted as spent, and the belt's airborne remainder is the fraction no account has ever been able to book as spent.

A body excluded from a congregation is buried by the congregation that excluded them, and the burial law written down is the cost of exclusion made explicit; on this belt the excluded are not bodies so much than an ore load, which is precisely why the law had to be written.

Qi law governs density and type and is one of the three groups a mortal world seats, and this body's filter is a direct instrument on it: it drinks the tier's qi out of its air rather than out of a reservoir, which is why the eighth gate is the one it cannot pass.

One recorded pairing between a salt body and a tide body, repeated until the household no longer surveys as either, and four generations have spent themselves proving that a crossing becomes a population only when somebody stops treating it as a curiosity.

A standing set of marriages between counting houses and underwriters kept because the two could not merge, and the marriage calendar is kept standing rather than convenient for exactly the population that can attend both a counting floor and a caravan.

Weddings are scheduled to the Tidemark so that the wedding season and the crossing window are the same weeks, and the only body that can attend a wedding and a crossing in the same fortnight is the one metabolising both chemistries.

A crossing schedule printed a season ahead and never shortened is what makes a toll defensable and a timetable not, and this body's whole range is the published window, so a crossed schedule is not a lost season but the loss of the only market it has.

On a coast whose temporal law was never written the clock drifts and a schedule has to be published against two tides a day instead of a calendar, and a body that lives in both chemistries has to live in both of those clocks as well.

Cloth and cut are supposed to say what a traveller is and what they may open, and this is the one body in the record that crosses a shoreline without a ritual, so there is no cut to issue and the credential culture has never been able to classify a carrier at all.

A price stated once in the league's own channel is a price the kelp season cannot sustain, and every attempt to state one has become a war, because the carrier who can hold both shores is the only party that can quote a price nobody else can hold for a whole season.

One house writes the contract and the other decides what it is worth, and the cross is the instrument that makes the second half possible: it arrives at whichever shore the first half did not price and sells the difference.

A household's standing in the salt dominion is the depth of water it may moor at and the basin's level rises and falls, so this is the one party to the dispute that can leave, which is exactly why the saltfolk cannot treat the dispute as something that resolves itself.

A counting house that answers access with a ledger, who may use the roads at what rate, and its exclusivity only holds because every member refuses a rival's goods; a population that spreads along trade routes is what makes the refusal worth the cost of keeping.

Underwriting a caravan against the road closing is a risk no market can price, because no tier below the spirit frame has a season to price it against, and the underwriter's only viable asset is a carrier that does not need either chemistry to be present.

The network works tailings on a severed frame that pays upkeep nobody collects and sells low-grade jade as spirit stone, and it is the one ore business on the setting that only a body which can walk onto a dormant isle and off it again can supply.

A seafaring trading culture that concluded its own arithmetic was the greater hazard and never recovered a price list, and the only population that agrees is the one whose value cannot be written down without becoming the first justification for taking its cargo.

Nobody on that tideline is inside or outside, only high, low or turning, and this body stands in both chemistries at once, so the shore's civic vocabulary is not a metaphor for it but the only description of it anyone has managed.

A league of the two coasts formed the moment the sea became worth owning, which is the first tier where a coastline holds its shape, and the league's entire commercial premise requires a member who can serve both shores without a change of body.

The kelp grows in the tideline and stops the moment the Tidemark turns against it, so the shelf's whole economy is a moving line, and a body that can metabolise either chemistry is what that moving line has been selecting for since before anybody recorded the crossing.

Passage is the only supply chain anybody can actually control between tiers and its cost rises about fortyfold per tier, so the population that is not trapped on either side is the population the tariff is priced on and the population the tariff is trying to catch.

The conversion that lets anybody price anything across four tiers running fifty to a hundred times a mortal's without ever computing a rate exists because carriers move the goods and the carriers are the ones who refuse to compute it out loud.

Once passage is known to be the only controllable wealth, a body that can cross a shoreline without a ritual stops being a curiosity and becomes the setting's most valuable single fact, which is the entire reason the crossing spread instead of staying one recorded pairing.

Counting seated groups against a tier's list is the method that settled the question of what a body can be, and this cross is the standing counter-example to its most natural mistake: the range widened and the eleventh-realm ceiling stayed exactly where the salt parent had it.

One tear has stood open long enough to be named, both sides write the same group at the same value and no tide has crossed it, and a body metabolising both chemistries is the obvious courier for exactly that crossing, which is why the question has a commercial stake nobody has been able to price.

A crossing is paid in grain and never in coin because grain is the only thing the mortal plains produces, so the treaty is denominated in the one commodity this population can carry out of a pan and deliver to a shore it does not live on.

An unanswered petition asking which of two published exclusivities governs a traveller's cloth is only necessary because one party to it is a body that crosses on no credential at all and therefore falls under both published exclusivities and neither.

The denomination forbids teaching any of the three Daos to a child before the child can read the law census and names Body Dao first, because the plains tier licenses no humanoid and a visiting teacher is the actual danger; a portably raised child is the case the rule was written against.

The border faith forbids any teaching, text or story describing the self leaving the body on the ground that such a teaching is a promise made on a body's behalf, and the promise this population lives inside is transit, which is why it is held as the sharpest of the four prohibitions.

A world boundary is the edge of a law budget, so crossing it means arriving where a group you relied on is unwritten, and this is the only body in the record for whom that cost is not paid: it carries both chemistries and therefore needs neither to be written.

A Dao is native to one tier and imported into the rest, so no tier ever holds its own practitioners, and a Dao migration is a physical movement of bodies between law budgets; the portable body is the only thing that has ever actually moved one.

The line guards one founder's forge relic and has refused every offer to sell, lend or exhibit, and a cairnborn is the caging itself, so the body's whole reason to exist and the household's whole reason to hold it are the same commitment made in two materials.

The Immortal Court's second layer is the one ground where a law is written twice and the second writing wins, and a keyed masonry body is what holds ground whose composition is unsettled, because it cannot be relocated and therefore cannot be re-keyed to a different list.

Every member came from a lineage that stopped one gate short of the ceiling with no cultivator left to produce, and this is the population that stops one gate short with no cultivator to produce by design; the two are the same arithmetic arriving from opposite directions.

A trial ground on a frame that cannot say where anything is is laid out as a ring of standing markers spaced by ear, and possession on the plains is proven by a marker standing, so this species is not merely the markers, it is the only marker that cannot be moved by the party disputing the claim.

The published explanation covers why the densest bodies in the setting stop at realm seventeen, one gate short of their tier, and it was written by people with a commercial interest in that hole staying a hole; this body's actual wall is the fourth gate and no naming reaches it.

The screen is built to fail at exactly the group the frame has not written so the absence shows as a gap in a wall instead of a hole in a person, and it exists because this body was the wall; the replacement was invented to stop asking the wall's owner what the wall thinks.

The densest bodies stop one gate short of the end of their own tier and whoever benefits from an unexplained ceiling wants the hole shut, while the single densest body in the record stops at the fourth gate for a reason that has been fully understood since it was first cast and is still not in the assay.

The cleft's moss maps the jade gradient and dies back over any cut ground, so cutting the jade also grazes the only map of where the seam runs, and the holdfast answers the loss of the map by keying bodies into the workings, which is the industry that keeps destroying it.

Every holder of that shore built their wall facing arrivals because a rift closes when the out-of-range law value returns inside its range, and a masonry body cannot be turned around once keyed, so the wall's orientation is a decision its owner can never revisit.

Ore is the one thing on the plains a core can be caged in, and the work at the face needs a body that carries and does not fatigue, so the guild's charter is also the setting's first written labour arrangement for a population that cannot be dismissed.

The lodge does not sell houses or passages but bodies already tuned to the frame on the far side of a tear, and this is the limiting case of the product: a body that exists on exactly one frame and cannot be carried to another at any price.

A guild of builders held together by a cold-bathing practice that hardens bone and closes the meridians against strain in bodies never designed to take the meridian burn, and this is the accident the practice was invented to survive: a body where hardening finished before the practice began.

The guild builds and then guards what it builds and takes as its measure that it is tested from the other side, so the only population that is permanently on the tested side is the one whose members were installed rather than invited.

A garrison holding ground its own faction cannot staff from, where every soul inside the walls is a visitor, is a fort whose wall can be staffed by a body that cannot be dismissed and cannot be posted: the wall is the garrison and the garrison is the reason the wall is not manned.

Jade runs as a gradient rather than a pocket so the cutters live in falling series of thin hard workings, and each working is a cut too small to be shored by anything that might leave, which is the entire architectural requirement this species was built for.

The lichen colonises worked stone wherever a large quantity of qi has been drawn through it and is the only reliable marker that a trial has been held, and this body carries it on its own interior, which is why it is the one cultivator in the record nobody has ever had to search for.

Iron ore is the mortal tier's only dense material and the only thing here a body can be caged in, and a masonry body is ore that achieved the same density metabolically, so the exhaustion of the seam is the end of the setting's densest body as well as its first bottleneck.

Jade holds qi and will not grow a crop, so whoever provisions the cutters owns the cleft more durably than whoever digs it, and a body that eats nothing and must be installed by hand is provisioned by the same clause that feeds everybody else on the site.

Realms three and four turned out to be a metallurgy problem before they were a spiritual one, and this is the population the problem created: a load-bearing body cast in the one material the tier could afford, in an era that thought it was building gates.

The densest bodies stop one gate short of the end of their own tier and the era that produced the stop has no spare seat to stand outside on, and a one-cavity interior with a tidal mineral circulation is the structure that consequence built and then could not explain.

The era that produced the stop is the one era with no spare seat to stand outside on, and a masonry body's single tidal cavity is exactly such a place: no second chamber to hold a law apart from its effect and observe it, so the one body in the setting designed to answer the question was designed to prevent it.

The class of mortal-tier offices that by construction can only be filled by non-residents is the reason a polity on the lowest tier is a caretaker government, and a body installed into a wall is the extreme non-resident: present, load-bearing, and accountable to nobody who can send it anywhere.

The plains faith holds that a person's core is a vessel and the ore is its seal, so the material was never a resource but a sacrament, and this species is the faith's doctrine arrived at chemically: a body that is its own seal and was cast as one.

No socket may be opened once sealed and reforging one is the one act the temple's own forge is not permitted to perform, and a masonry body's cavity can be re-cemented in principle at any time, which makes it the standing counterexample and the reason the prohibition names the forge itself.

Worked ore is brought from the temple's own face and the initiate's socket is opened and cemented in public with the amount used recorded, and this body is a permanent public seal with no initiate, which is why the rite is described rather than performed on it.

Physical law governs material hardness and energy density, and this is the mortal tier's answer to it taken far enough that the answer became a species: hardness is what made the frame durable and what removed the organ pairs the fifth gate demands.

A mortal world spends all three of its slots on physical, life and qi, so nothing on the plains can move its own size or open fresh rock, and this species is that absence made into a body: the limit is the only stable thing about it.

The household enters its dead as one declared group rather than keeping a roll, because the famine made every individual short of fuel at once, and this is the only population on the plains that can read what a body was actually short of and settle the count.

A line holding an asset that cannot be sold, cannot be proven and pays upkeep on nothing, and a species that can certify a death but has never once been able to certify an absence is the only population that could settle such a claim and never has.

A household that keeps the name of somebody who is not here and refuses to fill the gap is the setting's standing client for a body that reads what qi actually did to a corpse, which is the only evidence that distinguishes an absent husband from a dead one.

A bad grazing year is a medical shortage before it is a hunger and the dosing rule decides who gets it first, and the setting's densest source of reclaimed qi is a population that absorbs what is left in the dead, which is why the rule is written around them rather than against them.

The ledger is the working method for holding a vitrified body and the reason no glasskin has been born since: a frame raised its physical law to make material harder and every existing body failed in one night, so the only record that could hold a body was written by hands that never got to use it.

The mortal curriculum teaches physical, life and qi as a closed list rather than a foundation because a three-slot frame cannot carry a fourth subject, and this body runs gut to marrow with no dantian at all, so the reservoir the primer assumes is the one thing it has never had to learn.

A cave people's nervous system was outsourced to a symbiosis and their subspecies lost it and gained the mind path with it, and the only population that can tell an outsourced organ from an original one after death is the one that reads the dead for a living.

The basin's brine was replaced rather than lost so that everything the stranded body was built to drink became poison and everything it could tolerate became nutritionally empty, and nothing else on that pan could read the three declining generations as one continuous failure rather than three bad years.

A body arriving where a required law group is unwritten is injured rather than slowed, which is the claim the lodge's entire inventory rests on, and it was established from corpses: the only way to tell a slowed body from an injured one is to read what the frame did to it afterwards.

At a settlement funeral the dead are read as the frame said and not as the village remembers, and this population supplies the frame's reading without being asked for an opinion, which is precisely the arrangement that lets the two records drift apart for a decade before anyone notices.

A levy company is paid per name and keeps a roll of people who were levied and neither returned nor were recorded dead, so the roll grows and nothing on it closes, and this is the only population that could reduce that roll and is never asked because the answer costs money.

A fifty-year body whose fuel is its own furnace keeps the year's dead as a declared group because the population thinned at exactly the rate it could not stop, and the readers of that group are the population whose throughput rises when everybody else's declines.

The households the famine left still hold to the eating rules of the year there was nothing to eat, and the read that distinguishes a body fed from a body not fed is the only mechanism by which those rules can still be enforced against the people they were written for.

The Marshal commands nothing that can be counted and the levy is answered by people who may say no, so the office's only measurable asset is a schedule and a roll, and the one population that could prove which entries in that roll are wrong is the one nobody asks.

The plains' one large migratory herd returns on a cycle nobody has predicted and is therefore the tier's only moving calendar, and it is also the largest single annual mortality on the plains, so a body whose throughput is entirely a function of the dead is structurally obliged to follow it.

The mortal tier's only herb is medicine, feed and calories at once on ground that cannot be fenced, so the commons is grazed out in patches and the patch boundaries move with the season, which is what puts this population exactly where the standing herb is not.

The only account nobody can file is the one a single member keeps in their head, and this body's read of a corpse is the unrecorded figure that makes every other recorded one mean anything, which is why the register cannot be audited without destroying the thing it is auditing.

Realms five through nine closed a limit nobody was fighting, because a mortal world is capped at a hundred and admits only plants and beasts, so most cultivator death on the plains was not combat and not age, and this population is what made the distinction legible.

A fire-affinity population burning its own reserve for a decade produced bodies that no other reader could classify, and the shortage of expertise at that moment is what created the mortuary college's authority rather than the other way round.

One body returned from the twenty-ninth gate and cannot be examined twice because the second examination is what the first one prevented, and this is the only profession in the setting whose every examination is single-use by the nature of the work.

The March's highest seat is filled by a three-stage trial the office cannot judge and commands passage and nothing else, so the third stage's only evidence is who did not come back, and the office has never had a reader it could afford to employ.

The dead are opened, their usable ore recovered and the register records how much, which is the formal and versioned edition of exactly the reading this body performs for free, and the faith is preferred only because it produces a number.

Qi law governs density, type and tide, and this body is a direct instrument on density with no reservoir: qi enters in the gut lumen and leaves into the marrow and is never still, which is why the eleventh gate is meaningless for it rather than closed.

Six slots is the first budget that can hold all six groups and therefore the first tier that seats the extraordinary vessels, and this is the population for which that arrival is a structural non-event, which is why every reservoir gate is answered by throughput and none by storage.

The households the famine left still set the table for a year there was nothing to eat, and a body that metabolises fire is the only consumer on that ground for whom the rule is a supply policy rather than a memorial.

The one crossing between a burning body and a mineral one borrowed a furnace and kept the appetite, and this is that same metabolic commitment taken past the point an organic body can follow, which is why the cradle's line is thin and this species has no line at all.

The lexicon is a vocabulary for what a technique does where the law it needs is unwritten, not weaker but failing at full strength, and the only reading that tells a hole from a handicap, and on a world that spends its elemental slot elsewhere this species is that distinction made into a body.

Caging a forming core in iron is the one craft the mortal tier is trusted with, and the knowledge is intact while the ore is not, so the recipe's failure is the reason this population exists at all: an elemental is what a core became when nobody could build the cage.

Dosing schedules for a population whose fuel was its own body are kept by the households that had the tables and ate the medicine first, and there is no schedule here because there is no fuel, which makes this body the control the tables were never run against.

The Quench Order teaches deliberate spending of a furnace before it overflows and closes permanently the moment the body is lit, and this is the same burning as a body plan: no order, no operator and no closing, which is the dispute's whole difficulty stated anatomically.

One culture requires an unbroken shell and never displays the fragments again while another re-masters its symbols every generation, and a fire elemental does not distinguish a shell from fuel, so this species is the standing reason either arrangement is necessary.

Surplus law rises off the Immortal Court's surface and behaves like weather, feeding the ley from below, so the ley and the shelf are one system whose supply line belongs to nobody, and the densest continuous fire in the setting is the weather, not the furnace.

The mortal office certifies a breakthrough at the Cairn Field and is paid out of gate fees because the tier licenses no humanoid and a body cannot be judged by anything of its own, and this is the body whose certification belongs to a different department entirely.

The observation of a strained law only counts if it is repeated and one repetition is not evidence, and a population that is entirely present where a fire slot was not seated is the cheapest available repetition of that observation.

The deliberate spending of a furnace before it overflows, with a permanent closure the moment the body is lit, is this species' discipline read as a discipline: an elemental does not decide to close, it simply cannot stop being what it is.

A house marks its own threshold and renews the mark when the frame beneath it changes, admitting that a marked threshold may hold while the frame does not, and this body exists only where one specific frame is seated, so for it the mark and the frame are the same object.

The Regent sits where the crown is claimed to sit and the claim is not a crown, and the Court is also the one place in the setting with surplus law rising off its surface as weather, so the Court's heat is not a resource anyone administers.

The one authored elemental is licensed only at the immortal and transcendent tiers, so this species is the mortal-tier equivalent the tier's three slots cannot afford, and the difference between them is a budget rather than a biology.

A technique at full strength producing nothing is the signature an absence leaves rather than a weakness it has, and a world that spends its elemental slot on cold produces a different body entirely or none, so this population is the visible form of a vacancy.

The first resource priced by period rather than by weight, because a mortal lifespan inside the immortal world is a fixed term and upkeep rises fortyfold, and this is the one population with no term at all, which is why the Court's heat is free and its upkeep is not.

Ten seats over six laws leaves four duplicate imprints and nothing to put in them, so at this tier an elemental cannot gather the three groups one body needs into a single layer, and the empty seats are the reason the one authored elemental is licensed two tiers up.

A fire-affinity body with no elemental law seated beneath it burned its own reserve and died in a decade, and this species is the same fire with the seat supplied, which is why the famine reads as the moment the setting discovered the slot was optional.

Three attempts were made to seat elemental law in a spirit-tier frame and the record keeps one name and drops the other two, and every world that spent its slot wrongly or spent it twice is a world this species has never existed on and cannot be recorded from.

Every appointment passes a trial the naming office cannot judge, and this is the one body in the setting that holds no office, cannot be judged and would satisfy an appointment instantly, so the rule is the only thing between an elemental population and four vacant seats.

Elemental law governs dominant elements, balance and seasonal cycles, and this species is not a consequence of the law but its seat: where the group is written this body exists and where it is not written there is no such animal and no failure to explain.

An elemental is the first life form needing three law groups written into one body at once, so it appears exactly where a layer's share of the budget can gather them, and this species is the finding that the threshold is a budget and not a difficulty.

The clan holds no plot and no office, only a numbered place in a queue for tenure, and this is the body that queue is written about: a hundred-year frame with a ceiling of eight is a tenure instrument and nothing else, so the race and the land law were solved by the same arithmetic.

A household that carries the most ordinary concentration in the setting and has no bloodline of its own, only a habit of averaging whatever the household took in, which is this body's defining property restated at the scale of a family.

Children of the levy are called, fed, trained and entered nowhere because the March may call a levy and may not own a body, and this is the only population plentiful enough to be raised by a polity that is forbidden from raising it.

The mortal tier's whole curriculum teaches physical, life and qi as a closed list rather than a foundation, and this is the body the list was written for: nothing about its anatomy favours a path, so it must settle on one early and be weakest exactly where a specialist is strongest.

Iron tools on the plains are consumed by clearing spoil rather than by making anything, so a broken limb is set by hand with the same method for a century, which is the entire reason a tier with no qi still supports a craft.

An unwritten law has no dial and therefore no guarantee, so a community marks its own door and admits the mark may hold while the frame does not, and this is the population that lives permanently under somebody else's mark and pays for the renewal.

The Echoless is human in every measurable respect and qi-bearing in none, so it passes every gate as an unremarkable object, and the plain-dweller side of that dispute is made almost entirely of this body, which is why the prize is the right to be readable.

The colonized body and the mortuary college are the two sides, and the college's reading of a commonborn death is the frame's reading of the body its own population is, so the disagreement the colony started with reaches straight into every settlement on the plains.

The herb is medicine, feed and calories at once and regrows only as fast as it is grazed, so the two sides are the households that eat it and the guild that must feed its crews with it, and both sides are the same people on different weeks of the same year.

Realm nine was a limit nobody was issued, so the register exists to certify breakthroughs and deaths against a frame rather than a village, and this body supplies both: nearly every record in the college is a record of something this species did or failed to do.

A mutual society on the principle that a community's promise is re-made jointly once a year and never priced, which is the only form of insurance available to a population whose exposure is a season and whose assets are not portable enough to price.

A hundred-year body, a ceiling of eight realms and a frame seating only three laws, so nobody here expects to ascend and the work is judged by what survives the season; this is the race the culture was written to describe rather than to improve.

The last hour before a settlement falls silent is spent at the trading floor keeping up a hum no buyer admits to making, and this is the only body on the plains whose whole life fits inside that hour and nothing after it.

Distance is not conserved on the plains, so the only boundary fact anybody can establish is where people meet, and the two banks of one ford meeting at the crossing rather than beside it is the polity this population actually lives in.

The only plant authored into all four world tiers at once, because it is one of the three groups a mortal world seats, so the first rung of the ladder for this body is a plant that every tier can grow and none can do without.

The dynamic that keeps the bitter scrub alive and the mortal tier hungry is the whole of this body's food economy, and a population that eats its own seed stock is the reason the pressure has to be managed rather than merely endured.

Weigh, never quote, and let nobody make the first offer, because a buyer who names a figure first forfeits standing: a civic vocabulary with no word for price is the correct defence for a population that cannot move and cannot leave.

The commons cannot be fenced and does not come back faster than it is grazed, so this body's residence is the bit of ground where the herb is currently standing, which moves every season and is the reason nobody here holds a boundary.

Someone had to pay to open a world and the bill was written in law seats, so every world is a receipt, and the population that could not fund an ascent paid the next way instead, which is the whole of the Peak Ascent and the whole of this body's biography.

Realms five through nine closed on a limit nobody was fighting because a mortal world is capped at a hundred, and this is the frame the ceiling was measured against: the default body is the unit the hundred was counted in.

A levy company is paid per name and keeps a roll of people who were levied and neither returned nor were recorded dead, so the roll grows and nothing on it closes, and every name on it is a name this species answers to in every other context.

The mortal-tier offices that by construction can only be filled by non-residents are the reason a polity on the lowest tier is a caretaker government, and the residents who make them caretakers rather than a state are all of this one body.

The March's claim is institutional and its standing is earned and the two never read each other, so the claim is held together by a roll kept in the heads of the people on it, and this is the population the roll is made of and never consults.

Nothing was sealed, nothing survives and there is no second frame for a person to arrive in, which is the only afterlife belief available to a body with no qi to spend and no reservoir to unseal at burial, and it is the plains' largest congregation for that reason alone.

A body excluded from a congregation is buried by the congregation that excluded them, and the law requiring it is written down explicitly, because this is the population that gets excluded: it carries nothing, cultivates nothing and is indistinguishable from its neighbours in every measurement that matters.

Life law governs allowed life forms, evolution speed and intelligence ceiling, and this is the body's default product: the shape a life law writes when it is written at all and nothing else has claimed the slots.

Three slots spent on physical, life and qi means elemental, spatial and temporal are absent here, and this body is where all three absences are visible at once: no seasons to anchor to, no way to move its own size and no clock to promise anything by.

The mortal world that holds a hundred and admits plants and beasts, so this is the setting's floor and the only tier on which this body is not a visitor, which is the single advantage it has and the reason nobody on it wants to leave.

The single line the March charter names for the Keeper of the River Lantern, reduced to one thread by a cull, and a restored interior is the one asset that could refill a seat the charter has left empty for two generations, which is why this subspecies was not quietly interred with the rest.

A house whose real figures live in the head of one member who is not permitted to write them down, so a raid finds nothing to cite, and a body with its own unmediated interior is the only place in the setting where such a record is genuinely unbothered by confiscation.

A house that publishes technique, attendance and a chamber in full and takes discretion in return, so what is done inside is neither written nor repeated, and the discretion is only possible for a practitioner with an interior that nothing answers before the question is finished.

What the Held Note floor is actually a reading of is held by the office whose central etiquette is refusing to explain it, because a frame crowded enough that a law can be held apart from its effect is the top-tier version of a body with a cavity nobody else occupies.

A cave people's nervous system was outsourced to a symbiosis they did not choose and their subspecies lost it and gained the mind path with it, and this subspecies is the whole of one side of that dispute, recorded on a body where both effects can be measured against the parent.

The Court's second layer is the only place a law is written twice and the second writing wins, and an art survives by re-mastering its symbols every generation so nothing it built outlives a composition; replacing a symbiont is the same move made inside a body.

An academy that teaches by seating a law, diffing what the tier newly permits and then moving the student somewhere that law is missing, and this subspecies is a diff that was taken in a body: the symbiont removed, the mind path returned, the lifespan gone.

A lineage that has spent four generations buying its way out of the ledger and takes discretion in return for published teaching, which is the one arrangement on the plains that requires a practitioner who can hold something in their own head and act on it alone.

The culture's whole professional ethic is that a measurement taken by eye is provisional until someone has heard it, and the parent species reads surfaces by the pattern a hand makes on the wall, so the survey culture's best instrument is the one body on the plains that can also hear.

A people who measure a life by how many of the realm's gates were already closed when they were born, and this subspecies is the extreme case of that measure: it arrives with every path open, three quarters of a parent's lifespan, and no way to spend a century getting ready.

The pass polity's calendar is not its own, since the window is set by the Tidemark season, and a body whose whole life is a third of its parent's must book against a calendar owned by somebody else, which is the sharpest available definition of a short-lived professional.

The lichen colonises worked stone wherever a large quantity of qi has been drawn through it, and a mineral bloom holds qi rather than transacting with it, which is exactly the substrate the marker grows on and exactly the difference the subspecies is named for.

Spirit stone holds qi and a qi tide is the only way a strained law ever reads as smooth, so the stone bed is the first resource that makes a breakthrough schedulable, and this is the population that most needs it and can least afford to wait for the tide that is not coming.

The admission charge is the price of watching a breakthrough the tier itself is not licensed to attempt, and the mind path on the plains is precisely that attempt, so the fee that funds the mortal office is also the market this subspecies is the only local supplier for.

The three paths were separated and each was handed the tier it already occupied, and this subspecies is the split arriving inside a single lineage: the same body, the same parents, one path closed and another opened by a mineral accident.

The spirit tier completes in the one frame where all six laws are present and none is doubled, so the medium is exactly as large as the demand, and an interior that nothing occupies needs exactly that much room, which is why the subspecies' ceiling is unbounded and its lifespan is not.

A heresy is disputed over whether there is a test site, and the mind path on the mortal plains is a body with the mind path open, so this subspecies is the one piece of evidence that could settle the dispute and has been argued over rather than examined.

The seat exists and has no value rather than being a zero, and its succession is an heir under the March charter, so the vacancy is not an oversight but the arithmetic of a cull, and the population that could supply an heir is the one that had to give up its nerve to have a mind at all.

The school holds that the six law groups are the whole of what there is and the three Daos are three incompatible local readings of them, and this subspecies is a local reading arriving in hardware rather than in argument, which is the strongest form of the school's position.

The universe is a closed budget and every doctrine of a seventh group is an arithmetic error rather than a mystery, and this subspecies is the body where the budget closed and something inside it still answered, which is the one fact the school cannot file.

A unified Dao would need all six groups legible at once, which is a fifteen-slot budget, so three is not a tradition's taste but the largest coherent number, and the mind path on a three-slot frame is what that arithmetic looks like from inside a body.

A Dao is not a school of thought but a locally dominant reading of a world law set, and this subspecies is one reading written into the nervous system of a population that previously had none, so the philosophy is no longer held by anybody, only embodied.

The household behind the counting house spends its whole substance on an unwritten refusal to carry a rival's goods, and a population that cannot exist above a waterline is the only reason the refusal is enforceable: there is nowhere else for its members to buy.

A house that holds no jade and owns the workings anyway, because whoever provisions the cutters owns the cleft more durably than whoever digs it, and this subspecies is provisioned absolutely and without any arrangement, which is the purest version of the same dependency.

A debt evidenced by a stick broken between two parties, each keeping half, because after the Iron Grief the ground held no other record, and one indivisible line of brine is the only substance on this basin that can be split without either half being worthless.

The measured quantity of stone left per unit of ground worked is published before any sale and never after, and a salinity gradient is the same disclosure: publish it and every reader in the setting knows the exact depth at which this population stops.

An indemnity needs a stated exposure and the mutual society's whole protection is that it states nothing, and this population's exposure is a waterline that rises and falls with no act of anyone's, so it is the clearest case of a community that cannot be underwritten without being published.

A severed frame keeps paying upkeep nobody collects and the tailings on it are worth nothing where they lie and unmatchable ashore, which is the same shape as a body whose entire worth is located and none of whose output can leave without killing it.

The clan owns the brine line and this subspecies cannot leave it, so access to a substrate is administered by a counting house, and that single fact is the entire reason the population stays where it was pushed rather than moving back up the gradient.

The unbounded office of a house that hands out load and not edge and recognises no stat at all, and a body that has been specialised past its parent until the brine is a requirement is the purest available case of load being the whole of what anyone is owed.

A seafaring culture that concluded its own arithmetic was the greater hazard and never recovered a price list, and the deeper this population is specialised the more expensive any published figure on it becomes, so the concealment is no longer an ethical position but a survival condition.

The house's real figures live in the head of one member who is not permitted to write them down, and a house that wrote down its brine gradient would be advertising its own population's exit routes, which is the one disclosure the practice was invented to prevent.

A dominion whose territory is exactly its waterline because the brine never fails and everything else dies back, and this subspecies lives below the line the parent species moors at, so the dominion's deepest water is the one part of it with no administration at all.

The cleft's gradient makes the mine a falling series of thin, hard, increasingly deep workings rather than one large pocket, and this subspecies is that shape as an organism: tolerance up and mobility down along exactly one axis.

The dues are the March's entire obligation line, paid two parts at the crossing and one against the winter, and this population pays a toll to reach water it already lives in, which is why the toll is an index of the setting's willingness to move people rather than goods.

Houses that could not fund an cultivator's ascent culled their own branches because a line held pure inside one household concentrates faster, and this subspecies cannot fund an ascent at all since it cannot leave the basin, so its line is culled without ever having been viable.

The spirit tier opens at realms ten and eleven with the first composition in which nothing is missing, and eleven is exactly where this subspecies stops, so the era it lives through is the one era that introduced the reservoir vessels and the one that first showed it has no use for them.

Three surveys of the same anomaly disagree more sharply the longer they are repeated, and disagreement is what makes a certification necessary, so the basin's own level is an anomaly whose repeated survey is the only thing that could certify anybody's standing.

The college keeps one sealed case for every death it cannot certify because certifying a death needs a body, and this population taken above the brine line simply stops rather than dying, so its dead are the largest standing supply of cases nobody can close.

The Marshal's three stages run sworn at the ford, held the bridge, named by the March, and this population can be sworn at a ford and can never hold a bridge, so the middle stage is the whole of the ceiling on its social life as well as its physical one.

Sheds on the Sixfold Ridge are paid for in labour rotation and never in coin, which is why a faith with no doctrine can hold a border no garrison can afford, and a population provisioned in kind by its own basin is the same economy with the shrine removed.

No debt owed by a named person may be written down and the prohibition binds the Assembly's own members first, because naming a member of this population in a ledger is naming a coordinate, and a coordinate is the one thing it cannot afford to publish.

A slot is one law written at one value into one layer and law_slots counts imprints rather than distinct laws, so this subspecies is a single authored value carried to its limit: one measurement of brine concentration, sustained, with nothing else in the frame to move it.

Spatial law governs world size, dimensions and stability, and it is unwritten in the mortal tier, which is why nobody here can fence a habitat and why the population deepest into one waterline is the one nobody can legally reach or legally rescue.
